title: Normalized strict direct-image scalar interfaces
statement: For a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme morphism $f:Z\to X$, retain the strict reduction functor on good constructible representatives, its localization, and IntegralModel: a functor on integral constructible categories, a strict complex-of-towers realization, and its ambient direct-image reconstruction fixed by the actual quotient augmentation. Record additivity, constant-scalar linearity and the native shift compatibility. For an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in an independent universe, IntegralComparisons consists of such models at each finite coefficient subextension, normalized ordinary/derived scalar comparisons and integral comparisons. HasIntegralLaws is their conjugation and prescribed identity-extension law. Comparisons and HasComparisonLaws record raw rational direct images, identity localization components, localized integral comparison components, native shift compatibility, unit and cocycle. These are the existing interfaces, with their literal definitions unchanged.
